questions.question: What did Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego refuse to do?
options: Eat from the king's own table
Bow down to the golden image
Renounce the law of their God
questions.answer: Bow down to the golden image

questions.question: What did the king see in the fiery furnace?
options: The whole furnace gone suddenly cold and dark within it
An angel of God carrying them all up and out of the fire
Four men walking unharmed, the fourth like a son of the gods
Three men consumed all at once by the raging hot flames
questions.answer: Four men walking unharmed, the fourth like a son of the gods

questions.question: The three men told the king that even if God did not deliver them, they still would not serve his gods.
The furnace was heated _____ times more than usual.
Not a hair of their heads was singed, and there was no smell of _____ on them.
